item.title: 'Little White Girl' Amazed By Culture Becomes An Instant Meme, Deletes Video
item.description: Just A Little White Girl Amazed By Anything With Culture is a reaction image based on a video by TikTok user and streamer @categorylori where she sits in awe with her head in her hands, moving her head rhythmically, while listening to "DtMF" by Bad Bunny. The video was posted on or around February 10th, 2026 and has since been deleted. After it was posted, the video was screenshotted and spread online as the subject of mockery, also inspiring recreations and memes.

item.title: 'James Pierce,' The AI Counterpart To Villain 'Dany Slicer' Appears From Nowhere To Fight For Hope And Justice
item.description: James Pierce is an AI-generated character on TikTok (@thejames.pierce) made to combat Dany Slicer, another AI-generated character who went viral in February 2026 as the "ultimate villain of 2026." Pierce's account posted a series of photographs on February 12th, 2026 that are similar to Slicer's "villain" photos, quickly going viral. Pierce inspired memes over the following days that paint him as a hero and the "CEO of Goodcorp," whereas Slicer is referred to as the "CEO of Evilcorp."

item.title: Where Did This Painting of Sulley From Monsters Inc. Come From?
item.description: Bad Kitten Sulley Reaction or Creepy Sully, also known as MeatCanyon Sulley is a reaction image of a distorted artistic depiction of the character Sulley from the 2001 Disney film Monsters Inc. The image is derived from a January 2021 MeatCanyon thumbnail and is predominantly used on TikTok, becoming a popular reaction image on the app in late 2025 and early 2026.

item.title: Why Are These Roblox Parrots Going Viral? "I Just Get So Nervy" Explained
item.description: "I just get so nervy" refers to a meme derived from audio and clips taken from YouTuber nobrainjames's video in which James, utilizing a parrot avatar, clips audio from players using the voice chat feature in Roblox and plays it back as a means of "parroting" them. The meme began spreading in late January to February 2026 after several clips pulled from the original video were uploaded to TikTok and subsequently went viral.

item.title: 21 Years Ago Today, YouTube Was Founded
item.description: YouTube is a video hosting and sharing website. An hour of video is uploaded to the site every minute, with over 4 billion views a day.
